sources.entry: Pennywise - Pennywise opens any website or media in a small floating window that remains on top of all other applications. It's a great alternative to Helium.

summary.one_liner: Pennywise is a cross-platform desktop app that opens any website or media in a small floating window that stays on top of other applications.
summary.what_it_does: Pennywise loads a web page or media in a compact window that remains above all other open applications. The window can be resized, placed anywhere on screen, and given adjustable opacity. Keyboard shortcuts cover showing the URL bar, toggling a navbar, refreshing, switching opacity levels, and opening developer tools. A detached mode makes the window non-interactive so clicks pass through to the window below. For common video sites such as YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch and Daily Motion, it shows an auto-generated embed page by default, which can be turned off under Edit > Embed Videos. The README says it works on MacOS, Windows and Linux.
use_cases: keep a video tutorial visible while coding
float a calendar or checklist over other windows
show a live demo in real time while recording a course
watch video or streams while working
keep documentation visible when working on unfamiliar tech
use a web page as a desktop widget
how_to_run: Download and install the relevant distribution from the releases page.
git clone the repository, then run: yarn install
stack: Electron (implied by Chrome Pepperflash and desktop app context; not named in README)
notable: Always-on-top floating window with adjustable opacity and detached click-through mode
Auto-embed mode shows distraction-free video-only pages for YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch and similar sites
Installable via Homebrew cask on MacOS
caveats: The README says the project is not maintained and points to a different project, Always on Top.
Changing opacity is only supported on Windows and MacOS.
Flash support requires manually linking Chrome's Pepperflash plugin, and YouTube may not work for some restricted videos unless auto-embed is turned off.
